d:
Watch Yaendi Yaendi from Puli in Devi Sri Prasad's voice. Ilayathalapathy Vijay & Shruti Haasan, the lead pair of the film sings this romantic number in Vairamuthu's lyrics that will make you swoon!
Song Name - Yaendi Yaendi
Movie - Puli
Singer - Vijay & Shruti Haasan
Music - Devi Sri Prasad
Lyrics - Vairamuthu
Director - Chimbu Deven
Starring - Ilayathalapathy Vijay, Sridevi, Sudeep, Shruti Haasan, Hansika Motwani
